description: Active PreToolUse & PostToolUse Antibody Ledger — prevents repeating known mistakes across all sessions and workspaces.

antibodies.name: stop-hook-stdin-block
antibodies.symptom: Calling stop-hook.mjs directly in PowerShell without piping JSON to stdin hangs forever.
antibodies.root_cause: stop-hook.mjs calls fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8') on file descriptor 0 (stdin), blocking indefinitely until EOF if no pipe is connected.
antibodies.prevention: Always pipe JSON into stop-hook.mjs stdin or run gate-check.mjs --approve for gate verification.

antibodies.name: powershell-quoted-exe-missing-call-operator
antibodies.symptom: PowerShell throws ParserError: Unexpected token '-c' or similar when invoking a quoted .exe path at the start of a line.
antibodies.root_cause: In PowerShell, a quoted string at the start of a statement is parsed as a string literal unless preceded by the call operator (&).
antibodies.prevention: Prepend '& ' before quoted executable paths in PowerShell commands.

antibodies.name: freellmapi-no-windows-startup
antibodies.symptom: Adding FreeLLMAPI to Windows Startup bloats laptop boot time.
antibodies.root_cause: Operator explicitly mandated zero Windows Startup entries for FreeLLMAPI; it must only launch on-demand when port 3001 is called.
antibodies.prevention: Use c:\Users\avich\Downloads\mythos\freellmapi\ensure-freellmapi.js (WMI Win32_Process.Create on-demand launcher) instead of Windows Startup.

antibodies.name: windows-sync-spawn-handle-inheritance
antibodies.symptom: Spawning a persistent background daemon from inside a synchronous hook on Windows causes the parent spawnSync call to hang until timeout.
antibodies.root_cause: Windows child processes spawned via Node child_process.spawn can inherit stdout/stderr pipe handles from synchronous parent hooks.
antibodies.prevention: Launch persistent background daemons on Windows via WMI Win32_Process.Create (ShowWindow=0) so zero stdio handles are inherited.

antibodies.name: embeddinggemma2-fp16-nan
antibodies.symptom: EmbeddingGemma 2 returns NaN or silently degraded embeddings when loaded in float16.
antibodies.root_cause: EmbeddingGemma 2's activation range exceeds the dynamic range of IEEE 754 float16 (5-bit exponent).
antibodies.prevention: Always run google/embeddinggemma-2 in torch.bfloat16 (CUDA) or torch.float32 (CPU), never torch.float16.

antibodies.name: reference-image-forensic-8-axis
antibodies.symptom: Generated AI replacement images fail to match the exact pose, hex palette, and graphic artwork of the reference image.
antibodies.root_cause: Synthesizing prompts from product titles instead of extracting all 8 visual axes from the reference image first.
antibodies.prevention: Inspect the reference image via read_file, run 'cli-anything-google-vids --json prompt from-image <ref>', generate, strip watermark via gwr.mjs, and verify side-by-side.

antibodies.name: antigravity-hooks-json-no-quoted-paths
antibodies.symptom: Antigravity PreToolUse / PostToolUse / Stop hooks fail with 'Error: Cannot find module C:\Users\avich\Downloads\mythos\"C:\Users\avich\..."'.
antibodies.root_cause: Antigravity's hook runner splits command strings on spaces and spawns the binary directly without shell quote stripping, so literal quotes around a path are treated as a relative filename.
antibodies.prevention: In hooks.json, never wrap space-free .mjs script paths in escaped quotes (use 'node C:\Users\avich\.gemini\config\hooks\pre-tool-rtk.mjs').

antibodies.name: antigravity-posttooluse-no-decision-field
antibodies.symptom: Antigravity PostToolUse hook fails with 'failed to parse hook output JSON: proto: syntax error: unknown field "decision"'.
antibodies.root_cause: Antigravity's PostToolUse protobuf schema does not have a top-level 'decision' field (unlike PreToolUse and Stop).
antibodies.prevention: In PostToolUse hooks (such as post-edit-lint.mjs), output '{}' or '{ "systemMessage": "..." }' without a top-level 'decision' key.

antibodies.name: windows-node-fetch-abort-exit-crash
antibodies.symptom: Windows Node.js crashes with Assertion failed: !(handle->flags & UV_HANDLE_CLOSING), file src\win\async.c, line 76 on exit
antibodies.root_cause: Calling process.exit(0) immediately after fetch() with AbortSignal.timeout() while undici/AbortSignal libuv async handles are still closing on Windows
antibodies.prevention: Use node:http/node:https request with req.setTimeout() and set process.exitCode instead of calling process.exit() immediately after fetch()
